name: Work Redistribution Plan
description: Work time reduction measure within the framework of a work redistribution plan approved by the Minister of Employment and Labour

name: CLA 42 New Work Regimes
description: Systems provided for by the CBA No. 42 of 12 June 1987 on the introduction of new work schedules in companies. Hansenne experiments (R.D. 179 of 30/12/1982) are not included.

name: Complete Career Break (ONEm/WSE)
description: Complete interruption of professional career (only systems where an intervention by the ONEm or WSE (FL) is foreseen)

name: Partial Career Break (ONEm/WSE)
description: Partial interruption of professional career (only systems where an intervention by the ONEm or WSE (FL) is foreseen)

name: Adapted work with loss of remuneration
description: Adapted work with loss of remuneration, that is to say when the worker provides actual work services for which he receives reduced remuneration compared to that which he would normally have received (for example, returning to work after an illness with the authorization of the medical advisor); this applies both to the reduction of the hourly remuneration and to the reduction of the number of days (or hours) to be worked as well as when the combination of the two;

name: Public Sector / 4-Day Week (Contractual)
description: Reduction of working hours in the public sector in application of the law of 10 April 1995 (voluntary four-day week, early part-time retirement). Four-day week with or without a bonus (law of 19 July 2012) for contractual workers.

name: Unpaid Partial Absence (Contractual)
description: Leave for temporary part-time work for contractual workers in the public sector - unpaid partial absence; this should exclusively include systems for which no intervention by the ONEM or WSE (Flemish Region) is foreseen

name: Active Service Assimilation (Other Pay)
description: Absence (total or partial) assimilated to service activity or active service with remuneration other than the activity salary

name: Active Service Assimilation (Unpaid)
description: Absence (total or partial) assimilated to service activity and unpaid

name: Pre-retirement (Waiting Pay)
description: Absence (total or partial) assimilated to service activity, prior to retirement with waiting allowance

name: Parental Leave
description: Parental leave (total or partial absence)

name: Unpaid Leave (Prof. Activity)
description: Unpaid absence assimilated to service activity for the purpose of exercising a professional activity (internship, interim in education, mission, mandate, ...)

name: Personal Reasons / 4-Day Week (Statutory)
description: Prestations (partiellement) réduites pour convenances personnelles, ou toute forme de congé ou d'absence, totale ou partielle pour laquelle l'ajout à la liste annexée à la loi du 6 janvier 2014 est requis, et aussi longtemps que cet ajout n’a pas été fait, ou semaine de quatre jours sans prime (loi du 19 juillet 2012) pour les travailleurs statutaires.

name: Availability (Advancement Rights)
description: Availability (total or partial) with waiting allowance and maintaining the right to salary advancement

name: Availability (No Advancement)
description: Availability (total or partial) with waiting allowance and loss of the right to salary advancement

name: Pre-retirement Availability
description: Availability (total or partial) prior to retirement with waiting allowance

name: Unpaid Non-Activity / Military / Political
description: Unpaid absence (total or partial) with non-activity status, or availability without waiting allowance, or any form of unpaid non-activity for military personnel, or any form of unpaid absence or leave for a local political representative

name: Paid Non-Activity / Military Unauthorized
description: Paid absence (total or partial) with non-activity status or voluntary availability with professional activity without authorization for military personnel

name: Unpaid Leave (Non-Activity)
description: Leave without pay with non-activity status

name: General Interest Mission (Mgmt)
description: Official leave for a mission of general interest for the purpose of temporarily or provisionally exercising a management or supervisory function in a public service

name: 4-Day Week (Bonus) or 50/55+ Part-Time
description: Four-day week with a bonus or part-time work from age 50 or 55 (law of 19 July 2012) for statutory workers.

name: 4-Day Week (Bonus) or 50/55+ Part-Time
description: Leave or exemption from service granted to a member of the teaching staff for the purpose of temporarily or provisionally exercising another function in non-university education of the same Community.

name: 4-Day Week (Bonus) or 50/55+ Part-Time
description: Complete absence, assimilated to non-activity prior to pension and with a waiting allowance (operational police personnel).

name: Disciplinary Suspension (Local Rep)
description: Disciplinary suspension of a local representative

name: Phased Return to Work
description: Absence treated as active service with remuneration other than active pay: period of professional reintegration with part-time pay following illness

name: Statutory Breastfeeding Leave
description: Absence treated as active service with remuneration other than active pay: breastfeeding leave based on specific legislation

name: Precautionary Suspension
description: Absence treated as active service with remuneration other than active pay: preventive disciplinary suspension pending a decision

name: Availability / Job Loss (Education)
description: Availability (total or partial) due to lack of employment without waiting allowance (education)

name: Military Career Break (RTEIC-R)
description: Temporary withdrawal from employment through career interruption (military - RTEIC-R), or career interruption with an allowance paid by the employer

name: Military Health Withdrawal
description: Temporary withdrawal from employment for health reasons (military)

name: Military Disciplinary Withdrawal
description: Temporary withdrawal from employment by disciplinary measure or any other period of paid non-activity (military)

name: Care Leave (Employer Paid)
description: Leave or career interruption for palliative care, parental protection leave or career interruption for parental leave, leave or career interruption for caring for a seriously ill relative, with an allowance paid by the employer

name: Military Automatic Availability
description: Automatic availability (military)

name: Military Voluntary Availability
description: Voluntary availability (military)

name: Unpaid Care Leave
description: Unpaid absence treated as active service, for care-related grounds.

name: Unpaid Leave (No Care)
description: Unpaid absence treated as active service, without care-related grounds.

name: Unpaid Care Leave (Art. 16)
description: Unpaid absence treated as active service, for care-related grounds (Art. 16, Law of 06/01/2014).

name: Unpaid Leave (Art. 16)
description: Unpaid absence treated as active service, without care-related grounds (Art. 16, Law of 06/01/2014).

name: Medical Leave (With Seniority)
description: Unattached status with waiting allowance, maintaining seniority rights - medical grounds.

name: Non-Medical Leave (With Seniority)
description: Unattached status with waiting allowance, maintaining seniority rights - non-medical grounds.

name: Medical Leave (No Seniority)
description: Unattached status with waiting allowance, loss of seniority rights - medical grounds.

name: Non-Medical Leave (No Seniority)
description: Unattached status with waiting allowance, loss of seniority rights - non-medical grounds.

name: Senior Care Scheme (Statutory)
description: 4-day week or half-time work (age 50/55+) with bonus, statutory staff, for care-related grounds.

name: Senior Part-time (Statutory)
description: 4-day week or half-time work (age 50/55+) with bonus, statutory staff, without care-related grounds.

name: Reduced Hours Care (Contract)
description: Reduced working hours or 4-day week (with/without bonus), contractual staff, for care-related grounds.

name: Reduced Hours (Contractual)
description: Reduced working hours or 4-day week (with/without bonus), contractual staff, without care-related grounds.
